changelog: Dev build v843 - Fixed: the Automatic Updates switch in System settings felt dead. The row is deliberately non-persistent because the confirmation (and an optional parental PIN) owns the only write - but returning false from the change listener makes AndroidX revert the switch the instant it is tapped, so it snapped straight back before the dialog had a chance to decide. The tap now keeps the chosen position while the confirmation is open, a cancelled/back-dismissed confirmation re-syncs the row from the stored value instead of leaving a state that was never saved, and a tap rejected because another dialog is open also re-syncs. The switch therefore always mirrors what is actually stored, and the summary continues to distinguish Off / saved-but-paused / On. Tests: 4 new contract tests (row state text, switch mirrors the stored opt-in, listener keeps the visual choice, every dismissal path re-syncs). This dev build aggregates all current unpublished source in the shared CSM tree and is not an isolated patch.
message: Dev build v843 - Automatic Updates switch no longer snaps back and always shows the stored state
